remote.title: Remote access
remote.lead: Step by step help to stream games from this PC while you are away from home.
remote.never_web_ui: Web UI port TCP {port} (this management page)
remote.never_help: Do not add them to router port forwarding or firewall rules. Opened to the internet, anyone can try this management page or the device link.
remote.s0_text: To play away from home, your phone or PC outside has to find this home PC. Here is the easiest way first.
remote.s0_port_arbs: This is the ARBS-H port family. Its ports do not clash even when another Sunshine based program (Vibepollo, Apollo, ...) is installed on the same PC.
remote.d_overview: Picture: the home PC and a device outside connect through the internet
remote.d_vpn_alt: Picture: the home PC and a device outside connect through a VPN tunnel (no router settings)
remote.d_forward_alt: Picture: a device outside comes in through open router ports to the home PC
remote.s1_lead: Checked automatically. Addresses are only shown on this page; they are not saved or sent anywhere.
remote.s1_fallback: The detailed check could not be read, so only the configuration file is used.
remote.c_listeners_ok: The streaming server opened its ports.
remote.c_listeners_failed: The streaming server could not open some ports. Check whether another program uses the same ports, or change the port.
remote.c_listeners_unknown: The streaming server state could not be checked.
remote.c_access_this_pc: This page was opened on this PC.
remote.c_access_private: This page was opened from the home network (private address).
remote.c_access_cgnat: This page was opened with a 100.64 range address. You seem to be on Tailscale (it may also be a carrier range).
remote.c_access_public: This page was opened with an internet address. The management page may be open to the internet; check the risky settings below.
remote.c_access_ipv6: This page was opened with an IPv6 address.
remote.c_access_name: This page was opened with a host name.
remote.c_upnp_off: UPnP automatic port opening: off (recommended default)
remote.c_upnp_not_run: UPnP is on but has no result yet. Restart and wait a moment.
remote.c_upnp_ok: UPnP: the streaming ports are open on the router.
remote.c_upnp_private: UPnP: the router's outside address is not public (two routers or carrier CGNAT). Opening ports will hardly let devices in. Tailscale is recommended.
remote.c_upnp_failed: UPnP: the router did not open the ports.
remote.c_risk_ok: No risky setting: the management page cannot be opened from the internet.
remote.c_risk_wan: Risk: the management page is allowed from the internet (origin_web_ui_allowed = wan).
remote.c_risk_upnp_wan: Risk: UPnP is on together with internet access to the management page. ARBS-H never opens the management port on the router, but this combination is not recommended.
remote.c_overlap: This port family is the default of other Sunshine based programs (Vibepollo, Apollo, ...). Used on the same PC or behind the same router, the ports can clash.
remote.c_overlap_none: No clash with the default ports of other Sunshine based programs.
remote.c_low_port: The port is below 1029, so the HTTPS port would be below 1024 and may fail. Changing it to 1029 or higher is recommended.
remote.origin_to_lan: Allow the management page at home only (lan)
remote.s2_other: Other VPNs work too (for example Tailscale, ZeroTier).
remote.s2_q_router: Can you open your router's settings page and change settings yourself?
remote.s2_q_wan: Do you know whether the router's outside (internet) address is public?
remote.s2_result_forward: Port forwarding is possible too. Tailscale is still easier and safer to start with.
remote.n_already_tailscale: You seem to be on Tailscale already (it may also be a carrier range).
remote.n_wan_not_public: The router's outside address was found not to be public, so port forwarding is unlikely to work.
remote.n_unknown_means_tailscale: If you are not sure, Tailscale is the safest bet.
remote.m_upnp_text: Automatic, but risky depending on the router
remote.m_port_text: When ports clash with another program
remote.s3a_1: Install the Tailscale app on the home PC and on the device outside, and sign in with the same account.
remote.s3a_2: In Moonlight on the device outside, choose Add host and type the address below exactly.
remote.s3a_no_addr: No Tailscale address (100.x.y.z form) was found on this PC. Check that the Tailscale app is running.
remote.port_suffix_note: This PC does not use the default port (47989), so add :{port} after the address.
remote.s3a_3: If it is slow, check in the Tailscale app that the connection is direct (a relayed connection is too slow for streaming).
remote.s3a_4: Enter the PIN shown at the first connection on the device pairing page.
remote.s3a_web_yes: This page was opened with a 100.64 range address (looks like Tailscale).
remote.s3a_web_no: This page was not opened with a Tailscale address (normal when you are at home).
remote.s3a_enc: Tailscale already encrypts the connection, so ARBS-H keeps its same-network encryption (lan_encryption_mode) at 0 (off). If you share your tailnet with other people, change it to 1 (encrypted).
remote.copied: Copied. The address is visible when pasted, so take care when sharing your screen.
remote.copy_failed: Could not copy. Hold Show and write it down.
remote.share_warning: Do not send screenshots that show the address to other people.
remote.s3b_1: In the router settings, give this PC a fixed inside address (DHCP reservation).
remote.s3b_2: Add only the 6 rules below. Use the same number for the inside and the outside port.
remote.s3b_3: With two routers (the carrier box and your own router) the outer box may also need forwarding rules or bridge mode. This is the case when the router's outside address looks like 192.168.x.y, 10.x.y.z or the 100.64 range. If it gets hard, use Tailscale.
remote.s3b_addr_default: Outside, type the router's outside (internet) address in Moonlight.
remote.s3b_addr_port: Outside, type the router's outside (internet) address followed by :{port} in Moonlight.
remote.s3b_guides_other: For other routers, look for port forwarding in the manual on the maker's or carrier's official site.
remote.s3b_pairing: Once every device you use outside is paired, turn off new pairing so unknown devices cannot try a PIN. Turn it on again when you add another device.
remote.s3c_warn: UPnP lets any program ask the router to open ports, so it can be risky depending on the router's security. Many guides recommend turning UPnP off on the router.
remote.s3c_policy: Even when on, the management page (web UI) port is never opened (ARBS policy).
remote.s3c_restart: ARBS-H has to restart for a change to take effect.
remote.upnp_blocked_wan: UPnP cannot be turned on while the management page is allowed from the internet. First allow the management page at home only.
remote.igd_private_ip: Router's outside address is not public
remote.igd_disconnected: Router not connected to the internet
remote.s3d_benefit: With the ARBS-H port family (45989) the ports do not clash even when another Sunshine based program (Vibepollo, Apollo, ...) is installed on the same PC.
remote.s3d_e1: Devices already added may have to be added again with :port after the address (pairing looks to be kept). At home they are often found again automatically.
remote.s3d_e2: Router port forwarding rules have to use the new ports too.
remote.s3d_e3: The port of this management page changes to {port}. After the restart, open the new address (the browser may show the certificate warning again).
remote.w_overlaps_sunshine: Clashes with the default ports of other Sunshine based programs (47984~48010).
remote.w_dynamic_range: Overlaps the range Windows uses for temporary ports (49152 and up), so it may sometimes fail to open.
remote.s3d_saved: Saved. The new port takes effect when ARBS-H restarts.
remote.revert_blocked_origin: UPnP is on, so the management page cannot go back to being allowed from the internet. First turn UPnP off or put it back to its previous value.
remote.revert_blocked_upnp: The management page is allowed from the internet, so UPnP cannot go back to on. First allow the management page at home only.
remote.s4_1: Turn off Wi-Fi on your phone and connect to this PC in Moonlight over mobile data.
remote.s4_ok_text: You can now play from outside. If you used port forwarding, also turn off new pairing.
remote.f_cgnat: Carrier CGNAT: if the router's outside address is in the 100.64 range, port forwarding cannot work. Use Tailscale.
remote.f_double: Two routers (double NAT): the outer box also needs forwarding rules or bridge mode.
remote.f_relay: Tailscale relayed connection: without a direct connection it is slow or drops.
remote.f_firewall: A PC firewall or security program blocks it
remote.f_isp: The carrier blocks some ports (often hard to confirm)
remote.f_port: The :port after the address is missing (this PC's port: {port})
remote.f_moonlight: If Moonlight reports 47984 / 47989 as blocked but this PC uses other ports, that report does not apply (Moonlight only tests the default ports).
remote.s4_check_consent: Your browser opens this link itself. ARBS-H does not send the request for you. That service can see the public address you connect from.
remote.s5_lead: Settings this wizard changed. Previous value puts back the value from before the change.
remote.s5_none: No setting has been changed with this wizard.
remote.k_origin_web_ui_allowed: Who may open the management page
remote.s5_wan_enc: Internet connection encryption (wan_encryption_mode) stays at 1 (encrypt when possible). Now: {value}
remote.restart_needed: Saved. ARBS-H has to restart for it to take effect.

pair.title: Pair a device
pair.lead: Enter the PIN shown on the client (Moonlight and others) and approve it.
pair.step1: Pick this PC on the client. It shows a PIN.
pair.step2: Enter a device name and the PIN below, then press "Approve".
pair.name: Device name
pair.pin_help: Up to 4 digits. Leading zeros are added for you.

controller.lead: Let controllers such as the APEX feel the host game's rumble, triggers and HD haptics.
controller.input_help: When off, controller input from the client is ignored.
controller.gamepad_warning: This type has not been confirmed with ARBS yet. For ARBS, DualSense (usbip_ds5) is recommended.
controller.gamepad_help_hidden: Shows the value that is set now. It stays as it is until you pick another one.
controller.rumble_help: Sends the game's rumble to the client controller.
controller.trigger_disabled: Off (only if there is a problem)
controller.trigger_help: How adaptive trigger effects are reported to the game. Usually keep h2b. It is used only when the virtual gamepad connects as a DualSense.
controller.trigger_enabled_note: The current value is enabled (older method). h2b is recommended (enabled had no effect in device tests).
controller.trigger_off: Turn trigger status off (only if there is a problem)
controller.trigger_off_help: When on, no trigger status is sent (disabled). Use it only if triggers act strangely in a game; switching it back goes to h2b.
controller.trigger_restart: After saving, restart ARBS-H or reconnect the controller to apply it.
controller.gain_help: 0.0 to 4.0, default 1.0. Too high can sound distorted.
controller.per_app: The per-app HD haptics switch is on the Apps page. An app with it on connects as a DualSense while it runs, whatever type is chosen here.
controller.precise_help: Measures network time more precisely. On by default.
controller.precise_restart: After saving, restart ARBS-H to apply it.

gamepad_help.usbip_ds5: Passes rumble, trigger effects and HD haptics (needs usbip-win2, installed by the ARBS-H setup).
gamepad_help.auto: The APEX connects as a DualSense (needs usbip-win2). Other pads need extra drivers.

display.lead: Choose the display and resolution used for streaming, and recover display problems.
display.windows_only: This card is used on Windows only.
display.mode_help: A virtual display is not limited by the physical monitor's resolution.
display.resolution_manual: Fixed resolution (set the value in all settings)
display.resolution_help: Whether the display resolution changes when a stream starts.
display.reset_help: Forgets the saved display layout. Use it when the layout is wrong.
display.snapshot_old: It differs from the current layout
display.terminate_help: Ends a virtual display that is left over after streaming.

apps.lead: Add and edit the apps the client can launch.
apps.about_desktop_what: Shows the whole PC screen as it is.
apps.about_desktop_when: Use this in most cases and start games from the screen.
apps.about_steam_bp_what: Opens Steam in its big-screen (Big Picture) mode.
apps.about_steam_bp_when: Use it to pick Steam games with a gamepad. Ending the stream closes Big Picture.
apps.about_input_what: Sends only input (keyboard, mouse, etc.) to the PC, with no picture or sound.
apps.about_input_when: Use it to add controls to a screen another device is already showing.
apps.about_monitor_what: Creates an extra virtual monitor just for this device and shows it.
apps.about_monitor_when: Use it like a second monitor on the PC, separate from the game screen.
apps.not_arbs: Vibepollo feature, not related to ARBS haptics
apps.system_help: Brings back a default app you deleted, with its old settings when they were kept.
apps.system_present: Buttons for apps that are already in the list cannot be pressed.
apps.system_steam_bp: Steam Big Picture cannot be restored here. To use it again, create it with "Add app".
apps.name: Name
apps.cmd_help: Program path or command to run. Leave empty to show only the desktop.
apps.haptics_help: When on, this app connects as a DualSense while it runs, whatever the gamepad type, and gets PCM HD haptics (needs usbip-win2).
apps.load_failed: Could not load the app list.

stats.lead: See stream quality and stutter as numbers. Streaming now refreshes every 2 seconds.
stats.live_rtsp_note: Session history is off or not ready, so actual fps and jitter are not shown.
stats.rtt_note: The round trip between the PC and the device (network) is not here. Check it on the client (ARBS-W statistics).
stats.h_resolution: The picture size the client receives.
stats.h_fps: Pictures sent per second. The closer actual is to target, the smoother (95% or more good, under 90% bad).
stats.h_codec: How the picture is compressed (H.264, HEVC, AV1).
stats.h_bitrate: Data sent per second. Higher looks better, but above what the connection carries it stutters.
stats.h_loss: How often the client reported missing data. 0 is good; over 5% of the sent frames is bad.
stats.h_latency: Time the PC needs to compress one picture (not the network delay). 16 ms or less is good.
stats.h_jitter: How uneven the gaps between pictures are. 2 ms or less is good; more than one frame interval is bad.
stats.h_idr: How often a full picture was resent after a break. Fewer is better.
stats.h_uptime: How long this stream has been running.
stats.host_help: Close to 90% or more can raise encode latency and make the picture stutter.
stats.host_off: Host usage sampling is off (it can be turned on in the full settings).
stats.history_off: Session history is not available (turned off or not ready).
stats.verdict_help: Verdict: bad when losses are over 5% of the sent frames, caution when encode latency ever went over 16 ms or there was any loss, otherwise good.
stats.h_samples: How many measurements were recorded in this session.
stats.h_dropped: Pictures the PC dropped instead of sending. 0 is good.
stats.d_failed: Could not load the session details.
stats.history_enabled_help: When off, recent sessions and detailed numbers are not saved. On by default.
stats.history_ttl_help: History older than this many days is deleted. 0 = never delete. Default 30 days.

trouble.lead: End a stuck app, restart ARBS-H, or read the logs.
trouble.force_close_help: Ends the running app and the stream.
trouble.restart_help: Reads the settings again and starts over. Streaming stops.
trouble.start_with_windows_help: ARBS-H starts by itself when the PC turns on.
trouble.restart_also: "Restart ARBS-H" is in Quick actions above.
trouble.crash_help: Download the record of an unexpected exit.

account.lead: Sign out, change the password, and choose the appearance and the first page.
account.default_ui_help: The page that opens at the address /. Press "Save" after choosing.
account.default_ui_note: You can always open the classic interface at /?ui=classic.
